body: Built: Route/Mount (route.go), Failover (failover.go), Overlay (overlay.go), CachedRead+TrimCache (cachedisk.go), Batch (batch.go, used by DeleteKeys/DeletePrefix fallbacks), shared merged listing (listmerge.go), layer.Bandwidth/Fault/Hedge. Core hooks: Op.WrapBody, Op.Hedgeable; Stat/Read concurrency-safe. Conformance suite runs over route, failover, overlay, cached. Every feature test break-verified. Docs: docs/concepts/composing-disks.md (new), interceptors.md Step 10, layer/README.md rows. Not done: fs cp -r on Batch (cmd/fs not owned), docs/README.md index row, jobs TrimCache job, Failover as a Mirror option.
